d:
"Eyes on the prize – it's a hot day at the beach, and your sweaty hunky brogull is hornier than ever~ 💕

Ayden and the Brogulls comics belong to antidev
Thanks to vermonttheseagull for the original inspiration (explanation below - the story is WHACK haha) and title!!

Vermont showed me a cropped image of a club penguin's tank top from one of his own doodles, which I mistakenly thought was a cropped sketch of Ayden standing over the viewer with his arms up. Even after finding out the original inspiration image was of a club penguin, I refused to let this mistaken idea die, and so this was born hehe. To honor the original inspiration, I gave Ayden the original tank top the club penguin was wearing in the last two alts hehe.

I made a LOT of alts - mostly of different tank top designs I wanted to see Ayden wear - so hopefully there's something in here for everyone! 😉❤️

EDIT: added non-sweaty alts for the cowards out there >:3" - Artist
